embeddings: 7-dimensional truncated-SVD latent semantic embeddings on TF-IDF, fit corpus only
compute: CPU local, 2 torch threads, deterministic greedy decoding
cost_limit: Electricity and hardware cost not measured; zero API charge does not mean zero total cost.
limits: 20 authored questions, used as a fixed diagnostic set, not broad generalization.
Expected-answer substring accuracy and source-substring support are mechanical proxies; negation and aliases need human semantic review.
Guard may reject valid paraphrases and may accept a supported phrase answering the wrong question.
Toy fictional policies, no personal data, no actual institutional rules.
